title: Extending pyGMT into Deep Time via GPlately
description: An open, reproducible tutorial suite of eighty Jupyter notebooks that couples GPlately plate-tectonic reconstructions with pyGMT publication-quality maps, charts, and scientific plots. The suite is organised into eleven thematic clusters -- foundational paleo-Earth cartography; plate kinematics and tectonics; plate-model quality-control diagnostics; zircon-based tectonic-setting analyses; mantle dynamics and dynamic topography; paleomagnetism; paleo-geography, paleo-topography and thermochronology; sedimentary-basin architecture; paleo-biogeography; paleoclimate; and reconstruction-driven exploration for Earth resources -- and progresses within each cluster from an introductory single-concept example to a research-grade workflow. The suite executes on a laptop, ships with executed outputs preserved for instant visual feedback on GitHub, and is accompanied by per-notebook learning objectives, references, and an "Extend this" section. Nine of the eighty notebooks additionally depend on a large companion data archive distributed separately via Zenodo.
